primary.title: Notebooks
primary.author: Leonardo da Vinci
primary.rationale: Leonardo's extensive notebooks contain his observations, scientific studies, and artistic theories. They are a foundational primary source for understanding his mind and work.

primary.title: Treatise on Painting
primary.author: Leonardo da Vinci
primary.rationale: A compilation of Leonardo's writings on painting, perspective, and art theory, assembled posthumously. It offers direct insight into his artistic philosophy.

secondary.title: Leonardo da Vinci: The Flights of the Mind
secondary.author: Charles Nicholl
secondary.rationale: A highly regarded biography that delves deeply into Leonardo's life, work, and intellectual development, drawing extensively on his notebooks.

secondary.title: Leonardo da Vinci
secondary.author: Walter Isaacson
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and accessible biography that explores Leonardo's multifaceted genius, connecting his art, science, and personal life.

secondary.title: Leonardo da Vinci: Anatomist
secondary.author: Martin Clayton and Ron Philo
secondary.rationale: This scholarly work focuses specifically on Leonardo's anatomical studies, analyzing his drawings and notes to reveal his scientific rigor and understanding.

suggestions.notes: While Leonardo's notebooks are vast, they were not published in his lifetime and exist in fragmented forms. The 'Treatise on Painting' is a later compilation. Availability of specific editions on digital platforms can vary.
